title: Jnana Karma Sanyasa Yoga
translation: The Yoga of Knowledge and the Disciplines of Action
summary: Krishna reveals the divine history of the Gita and explains how knowledge of the self purifies and liberates one from the results of action.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम् |
विवस्वान्मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत् || १ ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead said: I taught this imperishable science of yoga to the sun-god, Vivasvan, and Vivasvan taught it to Manu, the father of mankind, and Manu in turn taught it to Ikshvaku.
verses.transliteration:
śrī-bhagavān uvāca
imaṁ vivasvate yogaṁ proktavān aham avyayam
vivasvān manave prāha manur ikṣvākave ’bravīt
verses.meaning: Imam - this; Vivasvate - to the sun-god; Yogam - science of yoga; Proktavan - instructed...

verses.sanskrit:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत |
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् || ७ ||
verses.translation: Whenever and wherever there is a decline in religious practice, O descendant of Bharata, and a predominant rise of irreligion—at that time I descend Myself.
verses.transliteration:
yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata
abhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṁ sṛjāmy aham
verses.meaning: Yada yada - whenever; Hi - certainly; Dharmasya - of religion; Glanih - discrepancies...

verses.sanskrit:
परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम् |
धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय सम्भवामि युगे युगे || ८ ||
verses.translation: In order to deliver the pious and to annihilate the miscreants, as well as to reestablish the principles of religion, I advent Myself millennium after millennium.
verses.transliteration:
paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṁ vināśāya ca duṣkṛtām
dharma-saṁsthāpanārthāya sambhavāmi yuge yuge
verses.meaning: Paritranaya - for the deliverance; Sadhunam - of the devotees; Vinashaya - for the annihilation...
